text: I would love to get a job as a designer.
But for now I’ll take any work.
You could work as a waiter
until you get an offer from a design company.
I’ve got a terrible cold at the moment.
It’s strange – I hardly ever get ill.
Oh dear. I hope you get better soon.
I really get on well with my new colleagues.
But I don’t get paid for the first month
so I can’t afford to go out for a while.
